task_description: Complete design system overhaul for Madarek EdTech platform: rebuild color/typography/spacing/shadow/transition tokens with new palette (primary blues #5B8DEF-#3B6CC7, teal #4ECDC4, gold #C8962E), redesign landing page to fix visual bugs and implement cohesive premium look, clean up CSS architecture removing duplicates and hardcoded colors, standardize responsive breakpoints, and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA contrast in both themes.

verification.summary: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot run npm install/build/test. (2) All 43 backward-compatible token aliases present. (3) Zero !important in landing.css and landing-pro.css. (4) Zero hardcoded hex colors in inline styles. (5) JSX balanced. (6) Cascade layers properly applied (@layer pages, @layer overrides). (7) Data-tone selectors consolidated. (8) CTA token references include hex fallbacks. (9) Review issues addressed in follow-up commit.
